build.buildCommand: cd pikzels-clone && npm ci && npx prisma generate && npm run build && npx tsc prisma/seed.ts --outDir dist/prisma --esModuleInterop --resolveJsonModule --skipLibCheck

deploy.startCommand: cd pikzels-clone && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma generate && npx tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node dist/server.js
